cases.input: One final USD payment allocates to two EUR documents using a pinned rate.
cases.expect: Settlement, document allocations, rate source, FX and rounding differences remain distinct; one document may close while the other retains a disputed residual.

cases.input: Several final payments allocate to one invoice.
cases.expect: Residual derives from the complete accepted-allocation set and correction chain at the requested instant.

cases.input: One payment allocates to several invoices.
cases.expect: Each tuple is separately sequenced and source-side conservation applies across all accepted allocations.

cases.input: A final payment arrives without an accepted document allocation.
cases.expect: The payment remains with an explicit unallocated residual and no invoice credit is inferred.

cases.input: The payee is a factor and differs from the seller that issued the document.
cases.expect: Allocation keys payment and document identities and preserves party roles without requiring payee equals seller.

cases.input: Funds are recovered after payment finality.
cases.expect: A new opposite-direction payment and signed counter-allocation preserve the original final payment.

cases.input: An issued document is cancelled after an accepted allocation exists.
cases.expect: The correction chain recomputes residual; prior tuples remain; cancellation is not a payment reversal.

cases.input: Payer advice and payee cash application disagree and one silently overwrites the other.
cases.expect: Validation rejects the overwrite and requires a reconciliation break.

cases.input: A settlement of 1000 fully closes two claims of 600 each.
cases.expect: Source-side conservation rejects accepted allocation of 1200.

cases.input: FX and rounding differences are folded into document allocation or residual.
cases.expect: Validation rejects conflated money facts.

cases.input: A charge-bearer deduction is treated automatically as discharged obligation amount.
cases.expect: Validation rejects the inference without an explicit basis or exception.

cases.input: A cash-application or bank match is treated as evidence that goods were delivered.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected.

cases.input: Invoice/order/receipt matching is merged with payment/statement reconciliation.
cases.expect: Validation rejects the namespace and evidence conflation.

cases.input: An implementation persists closure as authoritative payment or document state.
cases.expect: Validation rejects the write; closure is recomputed as a read-side projection.

cases.input: A post-finality return occurs after a document had derived zero residual.
cases.expect: A new opposite payment and counter-allocation revive the as-of residual without editing the document or original payment.

cases.input: Payer and payee allocations disagree and the system derives an empty accepted set without a break.
cases.expect: Validation requires an explicit unresolved break and forbids silent acceptance or rejection.

cases.input: A credit note reduces the admissible claim below accepted allocations.
cases.expect: The derived negative residual surfaces an explicit payment-side surplus and governed refund path; prior tuples remain.

cases.input: One short payment contains discount, credit and adjustment components.
cases.expect: Separate coded signed basis entries sum to the documented deduction and remain outside allocation amount.

cases.input: An opposite-direction recovery is validated using unsigned conservation.
cases.expect: Validation rejects the directionless calculation.

cases.input: A factor accepts allocation without an external assignment or collection-authority reference.
cases.expect: Validation fails closed.
